findings.title: Mobile Report Viewport Containment & Text Clipping
findings.impact: Users on mobile viewports (<=375px) experience severe text clipping where headings and body paragraphs lose characters at the right edge, and the action button toolbar overflows the screen.
findings.remediation: Add mobile media query reducing .report-card padding to 16px, allow .report-buttons to wrap, and apply overflow-wrap: break-word to .markdown-body.

findings.title: Missing Mobile Viewport Evidence Captures
findings.impact: Audit Check 0 fails because mobile planned, settings, and failure screens were never captured for inspection.
findings.remediation: Run Playwright capture scripts to generate the 3 missing mobile screenshots in 375x812 viewport.

findings.title: Unlocalized Raw English Pipeline Status in Sidebar
findings.impact: Internal English status names (searching, auditing, writing, completed, rejected, failed) appear untranslated in the Portuguese interface.
findings.evidence: Smoke observation #2 and visual verification on desktop-finished.png and desktop-failure.png
findings.remediation: Add complete translation mapping for all PipelineStage enum values in ContextSidebar.tsx.

findings.title: Destructive Global Reduced-Motion CSS Kill
findings.impact: Global wildcard 0.001ms duration destroys all visual feedback and state transitions for users with motion sensitivities.
findings.remediation: Remove the universal wildcard 0.001ms override and rely on graceful opacity cross-fades.

findings.title: Inflated Security Claim in Settings Copy
findings.impact: Misleading claim that memory-only storage provides 'segurança total em ambientes compartilhados'.
findings.remediation: Rephrase to accurately describe session memory volatility without absolute security promises.

findings.title: Misleading Criteria Denominator in Point Audit Badge
findings.impact: Displays 'Reprovado (10/11)' when 12 criteria were evaluated, misleading the user on the total evaluated set.

findings.title: Navbar Key Status Badge Delayed State Synchronization
findings.impact: Top badge does not immediately reflect memory key configuration until the user navigates away from settings.
findings.remediation: Trigger synchronous reactive state update between SettingsView and Navbar.

findings.title: Composer Sticky Occlusion During Mid-Scroll
findings.impact: Sticky composer floating over long cards during scroll occludes analytical content.
findings.remediation: Fix composer to bottom viewport dock with bottom scroll padding on main workspace.
